framing: request_wire = uvarint(len(request_payload)) || snappy framed(request_payload). Each response chunk = result code (1 byte) || [4 context bytes = genesis_hash[:4], only on SUCCESS chunks of bodies_by_range/2] || uvarint(len(payload)) || snappy framed(payload). Error chunks carry a UTF-8 message as payload. Snappy framing is golang/snappy's buffered writer; an encoder that chunks differently produces other bytes for the same payload, so implementations should compare payloads (and code/context bytes), and may compare whole wires only with the same framer.
